Basic image generation with a text prompt

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.image_generate_async(LiterLlm::CreateImageRequest.new(model: 'dall-e-3', n: 1, prompt: 'A white cat sitting on a windowsill', size: '1024x1024'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].url.inspect
```
